description: Scrub personal data, company names, requisites, secrets, optional commercial terms, custom_terms ([УСЛОВИЕ_N]), named custom_labels ({'ПРОЕКТ': ['Арктика-2']} -> [ПРОЕКТ_1]), custom_patterns ({'АРТИКУЛ': 'ART-\\d+'} -> [АРТИКУЛ_1]), and optional allow_terms exceptions. Free. Returns masked_text, items, summary, and data_guard_token for unmask_data or chat_completion.

allow_terms.description: Allowlist of terms, person names, or company names that must NOT be masked (matched across Russian grammatical cases).
allow_terms.title: Allow Terms

custom_labels.description: Named custom term groups mapped to custom placeholder prefixes, e.g. {'ПРОЕКТ': ['Арктика-2']} -> [ПРОЕКТ_1] across Russian grammatical cases.
custom_labels.title: Custom Labels

custom_patterns.description: Custom regular expression patterns mapped to placeholder prefixes, e.g. {'АРТИКУЛ': 'ART-\\d{4,8}', 'ЗАЯВКА': 'REQ-2026-\\d+'} -> [АРТИКУЛ_1], [ЗАЯВКА_1].
custom_patterns.title: Custom Patterns

custom_terms.description: Custom phrases (2-200 chars each) to mask across Russian grammatical cases as [УСЛОВИЕ_N].
custom_terms.title: Custom Terms

data_guard_token.description: Encrypted vault token (dg:v1:...) from a previous call to preserve placeholder numbering across turns.
data_guard_token.title: Data Guard Token

include_commercial.description: Also mask monetary amounts, percentages, contract numbers, volumes, and URLs.
include_commercial.title: Include Commercial

text.description: Text to scrub of personal data, company names, requisites, and secrets.
text.title: Text

name: scrub_data
